title: Исход 31 — Exodus 31
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Я избрал Веселиила, сына Урии, внука Хура из ___ Иуды.
cases.translation: I have chosen Bezalel, son of Uri, grandson of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from / out of) takes the genitive → рода.

cases.sentence: …и исполнил его ___ Божиим, мудростью, разумением, знанием и всяким мастерством.
cases.translation: …and filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and all skill.
cases.explain: The instrumental expresses that with which he was filled (исполнил духом) → духом.

cases.sentence: Он может воплощать свои замыслы в ___, серебре и бронзе.
cases.translation: He can carry out his designs in gold, silver, and bronze.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a material takes the prepositional → золоте.

cases.sentence: …может гранить и оправлять камни, резать по ___ и заниматься всяким ремеслом.
cases.translation: …he can cut and set stones, carve wood, and do all kinds of craft.
cases.explain: The preposition по (over / along a surface) takes the dative → дереву.

cases.sentence: Еще я дал Агалиава, ___ Ахисамаха, из рода Дана.
cases.translation: I have also given Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
cases.explain: Сына stands in apposition to the direct object of дал; for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive → сына.

cases.translation: Tell the Israelites: keep my Sabbaths.
cases.explain: Субботы is the direct object of соблюдайте (keep); for this inanimate feminine plural the accusative equals the nominative → субботы.

cases.sentence: …это будет ___ между мной и вами в грядущих поколениях.
cases.translation: …this will be a sign between me and you throughout the generations to come.
cases.explain: The predicate noun after будет ("will be a sign") takes the instrumental → знаком.

cases.sentence: …а на седьмой день отошел от ___ и дал себе отдых.
cases.translation: …and on the seventh day he rested from his labors and refreshed himself.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive → трудов (genitive plural).

reading.ru: Я избрал Веселиила, сына Урии, внука Хура из рода Иуды, и исполнил его Духом Божиим, мудростью, разумением, знанием и всяким мастерством.
reading.question: With what did God fill Bezalel?
options: The Spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and all skill
reading.correct: The Spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and all skill
reading.explain: God filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and every craft.

reading.ru: Еще я дал Агалиава, сына Ахисамаха, из рода Дана, ему в помощники
reading.question: Who was appointed as Bezalel's helper?
options: Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan
Hur, of the tribe of Judah
reading.correct: Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan
reading.explain: God gave Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as Bezalel's helper.

reading.ru: Соблюдайте субботу, она свята для вас.
reading.question: Why were the Israelites to keep the Sabbath?
options: Because it is holy to them
Because it is a market day
reading.correct: Because it is holy to them
reading.explain: They were to keep the Sabbath because it is holy to them.

reading.ru: Всякий, кто осквернит ее, будет предан смерти.
reading.question: What was the penalty for profaning the Sabbath?
reading.explain: Whoever profaned the Sabbath was to be put to death.

reading.ru: Заниматься делами следует шесть дней, а седьмой день — это суббота покоя, святыня Господа.
reading.question: What is the seventh day described as?
options: A Sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord
reading.correct: A Sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord
reading.explain: Work is done for six days, but the seventh is a Sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord.

reading.ru: Когда Господь закончил говорить с Моисеем на горе Синай, Он дал ему две каменные плитки свидетельства, на которых было написано «Перстом Божиим».
reading.question: What did the Lord give Moses on Mount Sinai?
options: Two stone tablets of the covenant written with God's finger
reading.correct: Two stone tablets of the covenant written with God's finger
reading.explain: When He finished speaking, the Lord gave Moses two stone tablets of the covenant written with God's finger.
